enrichment.headline: Awards Native Soil $55,000 to build a new garden irrigation system and drains at The Center
enrichment.summary: Native Soil, Inc. won this contract through competitive bidding. It will design and install a new irrigation system for the garden area, separate from the site landscape system, plus drains at the greenhouse and sink enclosure.
